name: MonarchAiStructuredAnswer
title: AiStructuredAnswer
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column card over MonarchDescriptionList, with MonarchBadge, MonarchAiMarkdown and androidx.compose.foundation.layout.FlowRow
summary: A model's structured output shown as labelled fields (text, lists, numbers, badges or Markdown) in a card marked AI answer, with placeholders for fields still streaming.
whenToUse: When the model returns structured data that people scan and compare: an interview brief, a lead summary, fields extracted from a document.
whenNotToUse: For a free-form answer, use MonarchAiMarkdown in the conversation. For many rows of the same shape, use MonarchAiTableAnswer. For facts the product already knows, use MonarchDescriptionList.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAiStructuredAnswer(schema: List<MonarchAiStructuredField>, data: Map<String, MonarchAiJSON>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, layout: MonarchAiStructuredAnswerLayout = MonarchAiStructuredAnswerLayout.List, streaming: Boolean = false, title: String? = null, locale: Locale? = null, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, onOpenLink: ((url: String) -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchAiStructuredAnswerLabels = MonarchAiStructuredAnswerLabels(), actions: (@Composable RowScope.() -> Unit)? = null)

class MonarchAiStructuredField(key: String, label: String, type: MonarchAiStructuredFieldType = MonarchAiStructuredFieldType.Text, format: ((Double) -> String)? = null, tone: ((value: String) -> MonarchTone)? = null, wide: Boolean? = null)
enum class MonarchAiStructuredFieldType { Text, List, Number, Badge, Markdown }
class MonarchAiStructuredAnswerLabels(aiAnswer: String? = null, pending: String? = null, empty: String? = null, complete: String? = null)

options.name: schema
options.description: The fields to show, in order: key, label, type, an optional number format, badge tone and wide flag. Values without a field are ignored.

options.name: data
options.description: The values by key, usually parsed with MonarchAiJSON.parse from the model's structured output. Treated as untrusted data.

options.name: layout
options.description: List: one field per row, label beside the value where there is room. Grid: label above value, two fields per row from 640dp wide.

options.name: streaming
options.description: The answer is still arriving: missing fields show a placeholder read as Still generating, and Response complete. is announced when it turns false.

options.name: title
options.description: A title under the AI answer label, such as Interview brief.

options.name: locale
options.description: The locale of Number fields. Null uses the configuration's locale.

options.name: icon
options.description: An AI glyph before the AI answer label, tinted in the AI color. Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: onOpenLink
options.description: Opens links in Markdown fields instead of the system browser.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for AI answer, Still generating, Not provided and Response complete.

options.name: actions
options.description: Controls under the fields, such as a copy button; they wrap onto more lines when narrow.

states.name: complete
states.description: Every field shows its value; a missing value shows a dash read as Not provided.

states.name: streaming
states.description: Fields still to come show a static bar in the AI subtle color, read as Still generating; the heading's state is Still generating.

states.name: grid
states.description: Labels sit above values, two fields per row from 640dp wide; List and Markdown fields take a whole row unless wide says otherwise.

appearance: A card on the surface color with the default border and large radius. The AI answer label (and the optional icon) is in the AI strong color, the title in the subheading style, labels in muted caption text and values in the body style. Badges use MonarchBadge tones; the placeholder bar uses the AI subtle color. The same roles adapt to dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web takes data as an object of unknown values and a schema with Intl.NumberFormatOptions; Android takes MonarchAiJSON values (the conversation model's JSON type) and an optional (Double) -> String format, with the locale as a java.util.Locale. The web's heading level is not offered: the AI answer label and title are one heading. The web's placeholder shimmers; on Android it is a still bar, so it needs no reduced-motion form. The grid's columns come from MonarchDescriptionList (two from 640dp) instead of responsive auto columns. The parity map lists ai-citation as a dependency, but the web component shows no citations; put MonarchAiCitation in the actions slot or after the card. iOS has no entry for this id yet. Experimental: a domain pattern until a Rook app adopts it.
accessibility: The AI answer label and the title are one TalkBack heading, so provenance is always read in words.
Each field is one element read as its label and value, from MonarchDescriptionList.
A field still to come is read as Still generating; an empty field after streaming as Not provided.
While streaming the heading's state description is Still generating.
Response complete. is announced once through a polite live region when streaming ends, never per field.
List bullets are hidden from TalkBack; links in Markdown fields and the actions stay separate elements.
Values wrap at the largest font scale and labels stack above values there.
edgeCases: Null, empty strings and empty arrays count as missing.
A Number field whose value is not a number shows the value as text; text such as 1,200 is read as a number.
A List field with a single value shows a list of one; null items in an array are skipped.
Objects and arrays in a Text field are shown as compact JSON.
Keep the schema stable while streaming so the layout does not jump.

examples.title: Interview brief
examples.template:
MonarchAiStructuredAnswer(
    schema = listOf(
        MonarchAiStructuredField({{schema.0.key}}, {{schema.0.label}}, MonarchAiStructuredFieldType.{{schema.0.type|pascal}}),
        MonarchAiStructuredField({{schema.1.key}}, {{schema.1.label}}, MonarchAiStructuredFieldType.{{schema.1.type|pascal}}),
        MonarchAiStructuredField({{schema.2.key}}, {{schema.2.label}}, MonarchAiStructuredFieldType.{{schema.2.type|pascal}}, tone = { {{schema.2.tone|tone}} }),
        MonarchAiStructuredField({{schema.3.key}}, {{schema.3.label}}, MonarchAiStructuredFieldType.{{schema.3.type|pascal}}),
        MonarchAiStructuredField({{schema.4.key}}, {{schema.4.label}}, MonarchAiStructuredFieldType.{{schema.4.type|pascal}}),
        MonarchAiStructuredField({{schema.5.key}}, {{schema.5.label}}, MonarchAiStructuredFieldType.{{schema.5.type|pascal}}),
        MonarchAiStructuredField({{schema.6.key}}, {{schema.6.label}}, MonarchAiStructuredFieldType.{{schema.6.type|pascal}}),
    ),
    data = mapOf(
        {{schema.0.key}} to MonarchAiJSON.Text({{brief.candidate}}),
        {{schema.1.key}} to MonarchAiJSON.Text({{brief.role}}),
        {{schema.2.key}} to MonarchAiJSON.Text({{brief.stage}}),
        {{schema.3.key}} to MonarchAiJSON.Number({{brief.score}}),
        {{schema.4.key}} to MonarchAiJSON.Array(listOf(MonarchAiJSON.Text({{brief.strengths.0}}), MonarchAiJSON.Text({{brief.strengths.1}}))),
        {{schema.5.key}} to MonarchAiJSON.Array(listOf(MonarchAiJSON.Text({{brief.risks.0}}))),
        {{schema.6.key}} to MonarchAiJSON.Text({{brief.summary}}),
    ),
    title = {{title}},
    icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Bot, contentDescription = null) },
)
examples.code:
MonarchAiStructuredAnswer(
    schema = listOf(
        MonarchAiStructuredField("candidate", "Candidate", MonarchAiStructuredFieldType.Text),
        MonarchAiStructuredField("role", "Role", MonarchAiStructuredFieldType.Text),
        MonarchAiStructuredField("stage", "Stage", MonarchAiStructuredFieldType.Badge, tone = { MonarchTone.Info }),
        MonarchAiStructuredField("score", "Overall score", MonarchAiStructuredFieldType.Number),
        MonarchAiStructuredField("strengths", "Strengths", MonarchAiStructuredFieldType.List),
        MonarchAiStructuredField("risks", "Open questions", MonarchAiStructuredFieldType.List),
        MonarchAiStructuredField("summary", "Summary", MonarchAiStructuredFieldType.Markdown),
    ),
    data = mapOf(
        "candidate" to MonarchAiJSON.Text("Alex Morgan"),
        "role" to MonarchAiJSON.Text("Senior engineer"),
        "stage" to MonarchAiJSON.Text("Final interview"),
        "score" to MonarchAiJSON.Number(4.2),
        "strengths" to MonarchAiJSON.Array(listOf(MonarchAiJSON.Text("Clear system design reasoning"), MonarchAiJSON.Text("Strong written communication"))),
        "risks" to MonarchAiJSON.Array(listOf(MonarchAiJSON.Text("Limited on-call experience"))),
        "summary" to MonarchAiJSON.Text("Interviewers agree on **technical depth**. Confirm availability for the start date."),
    ),
    title = "Interview brief",
    icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Bot, contentDescription = null) },
)

examples.title: Fields still streaming, with a copy action
examples.setup:
val schema = listOf(
    MonarchAiStructuredField("company", "Company"),
    MonarchAiStructuredField("summary", "Summary", MonarchAiStructuredFieldType.Markdown),
)
val data = mapOf("company" to MonarchAiJSON.Text("Acme"))
